notes: RBox expansion paired with history-replace-0011 (which makes 'assassinated' not a subproperty of 'killed'): a made-up relation, vorn_marked (person to person), is given the same property, applied to real pairs. Because the edit is a negative property ('not a subproperty'), the negation is its plain opposite, 'Is it true that vorn-marked is a subproperty of killed' (answer no).
